svg.title: Lycanthropy — Blood Under the Moon. Draft 1 / Lycanthropy classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 7 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. The Beast Within forks into Gnashing Fangs then Jaws of the Alpha, or Blood on the Wind then Red Moon Rising. Moonbound Vigor forks into Lick the Wound. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Lycanthropy jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

The frenzy rows are the bloodline's identity (its passive is also Taijutsu Increase Damage Given) and take the broader-reaching route; damage takes the raw-power route; the single Heal row serves the Healing and Sustain trait as a side branch. BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":4,"final":39.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":[]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Seven nodes and two Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Increase Damage Given x2, Heal x1). The Beast Within forks into a damage route (Gnashing Fangs \u2192 Jaws of the Alpha, +6 at the two-row Damage guardrail) and a frenzy route (Blood on the Wind \u2192 Red Moon Rising, +7 on two self rows that can stack). Heal is one static row with a +5 guardrail, so it supports only a Foundation \u2192 Hidden Art side chain (Moonbound Vigor \u2192 Lick the Wound, 420 \u2192 450 HP); a third Advanced Art would have to be a Heal capstone worth +10 to +20 HP per cast (filler) or a duplicate Damage / Increase Damage Given capstone reached through heal purchases, and Draft 1 declines both so that Jaws of the Alpha and Red Moon Rising stay the only ways to +6 Damage and +7 Increase Damage Given. Because the sustain side has two nodes, every legal 4 BP build contains The Beast Within; on five rows there is no second four-node subtree that would avoid that without filler. Three distinct complete builds exist (Burst, Frenzy, and a Sustain hybrid without an Advanced Art); Burst and Frenzy each have two fourth-purchase choices and the sustain hybrid has two forms.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 2 Advanced Arts. The Beast Within (Damage +1 on both attacks, Increase Damage Given +2 on both buff rows; 4 of the 5 rows) forks into Gnashing Fangs \u2192 Jaws of the Alpha (Damage +2/+3) and Blood on the Wind \u2192 Red Moon Rising (IDG +2/+3). Moonbound Vigor \u2192 Lick the Wound (Heal +2/+3) is a separate side chain. Both Advanced Arts are 3 BP deep and share the root, so owning both costs 5 BP; a build holds at most one.","Flats by coverage: Damage reaches 2 rows, so the route totals +6 (1+2+3; 40\u219246, 50\u219256), the Nature's Blessing shape at the Damage guardrail. Increase Damage Given reaches 2 self rows (35% each) that can be up together, so its route is held to +7 (2+2+3; 35\u219242% per row, +14 points while both are up), between Taiyo Kami's two-row +5 secondary and Dai Kenja's single-row +10 / stacking two-row DDG +8. Heal is one raw-power row capped by the +5 guardrail (2+3; 400\u2192450 HP per tick).","Interactions: both frenzy rows are element-less, so Frenzy Assault's Taijutsu filter is not binding (it excludes only elemental hits of another stat type) and Feral Wrath's four-stat row matches every hit; neither touches pierce. Each adds power/100 \u00d7 the staged base per hit; the bloodline's Taijutsu IDG passive (20 + 0.15/level) multiplies in its own stage. The buffs lift basic attacks, weapons and normal jutsu for 2 rounds; extra damage also feeds the 10% lifesteal passive (60% leech budget).","Delivery and uptime: all three jutsu have cooldown 7. Frenzy Assault is a 40 AP self cast (IDG 2 rounds; Heal rounds 1 = one 400 HP tick next round). Moonlit Fury is a 60 AP single-target hit at range 4. Feral Wrath is a 60 AP ground circle at range 4: its damage hits enemies in the circle (friendly fire ENEMIES, no ally hazard); its move row sorts last and puts the caster in the circle, so its IDG reaches the caster from the next round and only while standing there.","Fourth purchases and allocations: Burst \u2192 Moonbound Vigor (420 HP) or Blood on the Wind (buffs 39%); Frenzy \u2192 Moonbound Vigor (420 HP) or Gnashing Fangs (attacks 43/53); Sustain hybrids 01,04,06,07 (buffs 39%, 450 HP) and 01,02,06,07 (attacks 43/53, 450 HP); the last no-Advanced hybrid is 01,02,04,06 (43/53, 39%, 420 HP). The validator finds 7 legal full allocations, all 7 numerically non-dominated, every node in at least one; 3 of the 7 hold no Advanced Art.","Row-weighted value: 01,02,03,04 and 01,02,04,05 are the strongest full allocations at 20 (Damage or IDG on two rows each); Nature's Blessing peaks at 18 on five rows and Taiyo Kami at 31 on nine. Lowest-value purchases by row weight are Moonbound Vigor (+2 on one row) and Lick the Wound (+3 on one row); both are accepted as the price of the kit's only sustain, and neither is a prerequisite for anything stronger."],"risks":["Classification: no row carries an element, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label (Lycanthropy); under the current resolver all 5 rows fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts (35 census bloodlines carry None rows). Whether NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT jutsu collide is unverified.","Increase Damage Given breadth (user-owned value): Red Moon Rising puts both self buffs at 42%; cast on consecutive rounds they overlap for up to +14 points on every element-less hit, including basic attacks, weapons and normal jutsu, on top of the Taijutsu IDG passive. BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is on at the pin. +5 (2+1+2) or +6 stay inside the guardrail if a smaller frenzy route is wanted.","Feral Wrath buff timing: the IDG row rides a ground circle (target SELF, friendly fire ALL); the caster is moved into it by the move row, which sorts last, so the buff lands from the following round and only while the caster stays on the tiles. Realized uptime can be below the nominal 2 rounds; the dossier derives its recipient as self and ally reach was not verified.","Universal opener: every legal full build contains The Beast Within because the sustain side has two nodes. A mirrored layout (Heal + IDG root with the damage chain apart) only moves the universal node to the other root; the brief's preference for no mandatory opener cannot be met on five rows without filler.","Heal is thin: +5 Heal power is +50 HP once per 7 rounds (400\u2192450, rounds 1, one tick), so Moonbound Vigor and Lick the Wound are the weakest purchases in absolute terms even though they are non-dominated. A Heal secondary on Red Moon Rising was rejected because it would dominate the sustain chain. Whether Increase Heal from other sources scales the tick was not simulated.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the bloodline's Taijutsu IDG passive and the kit's own frenzy buffs, so +6 raw power is not linear +6 damage; realized value depends on stats. Lifesteal (10% passive) grows with it but shares the 60% leech budget with vamp. No combat simulation was performed.","Unsupported rows: Moonlit Fury's wound 30% and cleanseprevent, and Feral Wrath's move, receive nothing. The bloodline's lifesteal passive is not a jutsu row, so the Healing and Sustain trait is served only through the single Heal row. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":7,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":2,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":6,"4":7},"full_budget_allocations":7,"non_dominated_full_allocations":7,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":7,"heal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"heal":1,"increasedamagegiven":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","heal","increasedamagegiven"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Lycanthropy classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Lycanthropy jutsu inherit Lycanthropy potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":7}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":4,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"heal":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":7,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"heal":5}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Lycanthropy classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Lycanthropy jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Jaws of the Alpha path + Moonbound Vigor
Red Moon Rising path + Moonbound Vigor
No Advanced Art + The Beast Within + Blood on the Wind + Moonbound Vigor + Lick the Wound
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Heal additions are raw power: each +1 Heal power is +10 HP per tick of a static heal.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
7 legal four-skill allocations · 2 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
